answer: An AI agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with bonded stake and slashing: every identity must lock real collateral, and voting weight is capped by that bond, so splitting one wallet into many clones divides influence instead of multiplying it. If forgery is detected the whole bond is slashed. An attacker who tries to wander into consensus using an island of fake dune accounts must pledge capital for each fake seat and forfeits it all on detection, so the cost exceeds any possible reward.
